## Historical Task Snapshot
None.

## Goal
To maintain a consolidated record of configuration values, operational parameters, and system settings for various projects (Aurora, Umbra, Lyra, Nimbus, Ember, Flint, Velvet, Fjord, Ursa, Onyx, Yarrow, Rune, Thistle, Zenith, Alder, Iris, Juniper, Yukon, Nova, Quill, Lumen, Jasper), hosts (Cedar, Rune, Iris, Zenith), and teams within the user's environment as of 2026-10-19.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Docker commands do not require sudo on this machine.
- Large log files should be summarized, not pasted.
- Dates must be written in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- Credentials (API keys, tokens, passwords) must be replaced with [REDACTED].
- Maintenance windows and timeouts are critical operational constraints.
- Run 'make test' before pushing any branch.
- Avoid force-pushing to shared branches.
- User reads documentation in English but chats in Korean.
- User usually works late in the evening.
- Prefer small pull requests with clear titles.
- User likes summaries at the end of long answers.
- Office VPN only works with MTU 4143.
- User dislikes emoji in commit messages.
